import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Feature engineering for string column f_27
def extract_string_features(df, col="f_27"):
    df = df.copy()
    # Extract character positions
    for i in range(10):
        df[f"f27_char_{i}"] = df[col].str[i]

    # Character counts
    for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
        df[f"f27_{char}_count"] = df[col].str.count(char)

    # Unique character count
    df["f27_unique_chars"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))

    # Position of first and last B
    df["f27_first_B"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: x.find("B"))
    df["f27_last_B"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: x.rfind("B"))

    # Sum of letter counts (A-J only, as they appear in training data)
    df["f27_AJ_sum"] = sum(df[f"f27_{c}_count"] for c in "ABCDEFGHIJ")

    # Simple string length (should be 10 but just in case)
    df["f27_len"] = df[col].str.len()

    # Extract bigram counts (consecutive character pairs)
    bigrams = [
        "AB",
        "BC",
        "CD",
        "DE",
        "EF",
        "FG",
        "GH",
        "HI",
        "IJ",
        "JK",
        "KL",
        "LM",
        "MN",
        "NO",
        "OP",
        "PQ",
        "QR",
        "RS",
        "ST",
        "TU",
        "UV",
        "VW",
        "WX",
        "XY",
        "YZ",
        "AA",
        "BB",
        "CC",
        "DD",
        "EE",
        "FF",
        "GG",
        "HH",
        "II",
        "JJ",
        "KK",
        "LL",
        "MM",
        "NN",
        "OO",
        "PP",
        "QQ",
        "RR",
        "SS",
        "TT",
        "UU",
        "VV",
        "WW",
        "XX",
        "YY",
        "ZZ",
    ]
    for bg in bigrams:
        df[f"f27_{bg}_count"] = df[col].str.count(bg)

    # Count of vowels vs consonants
    vowels = "AEIOU"
    df["f27_vowel_count"] = sum(df[f"f27_{v}_count"] for v in vowels)
    df["f27_consonant_count"] = df["f27_len"] - df["f27_vowel_count"]

    return df


# Apply feature engineering
train = extract_string_features(train)
test = extract_string_features(test)

# Drop original string column and target
drop_cols = ["id", "f_27", "target"]
feature_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in drop_cols]

# Identify categorical vs numeric features for encoding
cat_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if train[c].dtype == "object"]
num_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in cat_cols]

# Label encode categorical features
le_dict = {}
for col in cat_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    combined = pd.concat([train[col], test[col]], axis=0).astype(str)
    le.fit(combined)
    train[col] = le.transform(train[col].astype(str))
    test[col] = le.transform(test[col].astype(str))
    le_dict[col] = le

# Prepare data
X = train[feature_cols].copy()
y = train["target"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()

# Add pairwise interaction features among numeric columns (only top 10 based on variance/importance proxy)
num_cols_sorted = sorted(num_cols, key=lambda c: train[c].std(), reverse=True)[:10]
pairwise_cols = []
for i in range(len(num_cols_sorted)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(num_cols_sorted)):
        col1, col2 = num_cols_sorted[i], num_cols_sorted[j]
        X[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = X[col1] * X[col2]
        X_test[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = X_test[col1] * X_test[col2]
        pairwise_cols.append(f"{col1}_x_{col2}")

# Add row-wise summary statistics for numeric features
X["num_sum"] = X[num_cols].sum(axis=1)
X["num_mean"] = X[num_cols].mean(axis=1)
X["num_std"] = X[num_cols].std(axis=1)
X["num_min"] = X[num_cols].min(axis=1)
X["num_max"] = X[num_cols].max(axis=1)

X_test["num_sum"] = X_test[num_cols].sum(axis=1)
X_test["num_mean"] = X_test[num_cols].mean(axis=1)
X_test["num_std"] = X_test[num_cols].std(axis=1)
X_test["num_min"] = X_test[num_cols].min(axis=1)
X_test["num_max"] = X_test[num_cols].max(axis=1)

# NEW: Add rank-based features for numeric columns
X_rank = X[num_cols].rank(axis=1, method="average")
X_test_rank = X_test[num_cols].rank(axis=1, method="average")

X["rank_mean"] = X_rank.mean(axis=1)
X["rank_std"] = X_rank.std(axis=1)
X["rank_max"] = X_rank.max(axis=1)
X["rank_min"] = X_rank.min(axis=1)

X_test["rank_mean"] = X_test_rank.mean(axis=1)
X_test["rank_std"] = X_test_rank.std(axis=1)
X_test["rank_max"] = X_test_rank.max(axis=1)
X_test["rank_min"] = X_test_rank.min(axis=1)

# Add top-3 numeric feature values per row
for i in range(3):
    X[f"top{i+1}_num"] = np.where(
        X_rank == (len(num_cols) - i), X[num_cols], np.nan
    ).max(axis=1)
    X_test[f"top{i+1}_num"] = np.where(
        X_test_rank == (len(num_cols) - i), X_test[num_cols], np.nan
    ).max(axis=1)

# NEW: Add modular arithmetic features for numeric columns (f_00 to f_26)
numeric_cols_00_26 = [
    c
    for c in num_cols
    if c.startswith("f_0")
    or (c.startswith("f_1") or c.startswith("f_2") and len(c) <= 4)
]
if not numeric_cols_00_26:
    numeric_cols_00_26 = [
        c for c in num_cols if int(c.split("_")[1].split("f_")[1]) <= 26
    ]

X_mod3_sum = X[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(3).sum(axis=1)
X_mod3_count = (X[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(3) == 0).sum(axis=1)
X_mod7_sum = X[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(7).sum(axis=1)
X_mod7_count = (X[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(7) == 0).sum(axis=1)

X["mod3_sum"] = X_mod3_sum.values
X["mod3_count"] = X_mod3_count.values
X["mod7_sum"] = X_mod7_sum.values
X["mod7_count"] = X_mod7_count.values

X_test_mod3_sum = X_test[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(3).sum(axis=1)
X_test_mod3_count = (X_test[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(3) == 0).sum(axis=1)
X_test_mod7_sum = X_test[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(7).sum(axis=1)
X_test_mod7_count = (X_test[numeric_cols_00_26].mod(7) == 0).sum(axis=1)

X_test["mod3_sum"] = X_test_mod3_sum.values
X_test["mod3_count"] = X_test_mod3_count.values
X_test["mod7_sum"] = X_test_mod7_sum.values
X_test["mod7_count"] = X_test_mod7_count.values

# NEW: Add polynomial features (degree 2) for top 5 numeric features by variance
top5_num_cols = sorted(num_cols, key=lambda c: train[c].std(), reverse=True)[:5]
for col in top5_num_cols:
    X[f"{col}_poly2"] = X[col] ** 2
    X_test[f"{col}_poly2"] = X_test[col] ** 2

# NEW: Interaction features between modular arithmetic and numeric summaries
X["mod3_sum_x_num_mean"] = X["mod3_sum"] * X["num_mean"]
X["mod7_sum_x_num_std"] = X["mod7_sum"] * X["num_std"]
X["mod3_count_x_num_sum"] = X["mod3_count"] * X["num_sum"]

X_test["mod3_sum_x_num_mean"] = X_test["mod3_sum"] * X_test["num_mean"]
X_test["mod7_sum_x_num_std"] = X_test["mod7_sum"] * X_test["num_std"]
X_test["mod3_count_x_num_sum"] = X_test["mod3_count"] * X_test["num_sum"]

# NEW: Count bigrams from string column
bigram_cols = [
    c
    for c in X.columns
    if c.startswith("f27_") and "_count" in c and len(c.split("_")) == 4
]
X_bigram_sum = X[bigram_cols].sum(axis=1)
X_test_bigram_sum = X_test[bigram_cols].sum(axis=1)
X["bigram_sum"] = X_bigram_sum.values
X_test["bigram_sum"] = X_test_bigram_sum.values

# Stratified train/validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# LightGBM parameters (tuned for interaction-rich data)
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.03,
    "feature_fraction": 0.85,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.85,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 15,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Create LightGBM dataset
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train model with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validate
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"].values, "target": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
